h1: Move management for offices and commercial facilities
lead: BRS coordinates every phase of your move, from pre-planning to finalization, so operations keep running whether you relocate a department or a whole facility.
card_blurb: Coordinated planning, task delegation and execution for commercial moves of any size.
meta_description: BRS coordinates each phase of a commercial move, from pre-planning and task delegation to execution and finalization, on-site or remotely.
overview: Modern offices are always changing. Teams grow, desks are reassigned and departments reorganize. Moves become frequent, and they need a system behind them.

Move management is the coordination of every phase of a move so it runs smoothly at any scale. A clear approach reduces obstacles and keeps operations flowing, whether you are reorganizing a department or occupying a new facility.
Business Relocation Services (BRS) has done this work since 1987. We can supplement your internal move team or coordinate any or all aspects of your relocation.

benefits.title: One coordinated plan
benefits.text: Every phase of the move is planned and tracked, so nothing is left to chance.

benefits.title: Less disruption to operations
benefits.text: Structured planning helps your business keep its performance and productivity during the move.

benefits.title: Support that fits your team
benefits.text: We work alongside your existing move team or take on as much of the coordination as you need.

included: Task delegation across teams and vendors
Settling in at the new space
Support for any existing internal move team
Departmental reorganizations and full facility moves

process.title: Pre-plan
process.text: We define scope, schedule and responsibilities before anything is packed.

process.title: Delegate tasks
process.text: Each task has an owner, so your team and ours know who does what.

process.title: Execute the move
process.text: We coordinate the move itself and keep communication open.

process.title: Settle and finalize
process.text: We help your teams settle into the new space and close out the project.

who_for: Companies moving to a new facility
Businesses with agile or hot-desk workplaces
Facilities teams that need extra move support

faq.a: It covers the phases of a move: pre-planning, task delegation, move execution, settling in and finalization.

faq.q: Can you work with our internal move team?
faq.a: Yes. We supplement an existing internal team and can coordinate any or all aspects of the relocation.

faq.q: Do you manage moves for companies outside our region?
faq.a: BRS moves clients in New York, New Jersey and Pennsylvania, and corporate relocation project management is available to clients anywhere in the US.
